penalties_raw.detail: The description is overly verbose, repeating information about the structure and alignment unnecessarily.
penalties_raw.text_span: The pie chart visually illustrates a taxonomy of medical ethics, structured as a two-tiered circular diagram. The inner circle is divided into four color-coded segments representing the foundational ethical principles in medicine: “Beneficence” (large blue segment), “Non-Maleficence” (purple), “Autonomy” (green), and “Justice” (orange). Surrounding this core, the outer ring is segmented into 26 distinct categories—each corresponding to a cluster of detailed ethical principles derived from a larger set of 256—radiating outward and aligned with their respective pillar.
